ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black) to 40% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black central field. Left lobe contains a cluster of high-contrast white mottling in the distal mid-section. Right lobe features a large diagonal swath of white pixels from the leading edge toward the center, overlaid with dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 110 degrees and a defined vertex point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular peaks and deep valleys. Right lobe trailing edge displays lower-amplitude, higher-frequency serrations with a more uniform distribution.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit continuous convexity. Trailing edges follow a concave sweep from the median notch towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white spots on the lower right lobe near the water interface. A dark, irregular mass at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of parallel, dark linear pixel streaks (rake marks) cutting through the high-intensity white field on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Structural deformity and reddish-brown pixel discoloration at the tip of the left lobe indicating physical trauma. Parallel linear scarring on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, unusually deep secondary notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the tip to the center.
